note: Policy implemented: NEVER delete. Untouched orphan -> archived (US-PM-16 flag, status/title/body preserved, Store.unarchive reverses); touched orphan -> left byte-for-byte and flagged. Rejected the "delete when untouched" half of the proposal: the task body is the only surviving record of a dropped criterion, and the matcher is a heuristic whose known misfire (rewording past the similarity threshold) would become unrecoverable loss under delete. "Untouched" widened past the proposal to 6 codes: status-not-todo, assigned, run-log-entries, title-edited, has-dependencies, has-dependents. Human-edited body and already-archived tasks never enter reconciliation at all. Machine-readable: each orphan carries action (archive|flag) + work_reasons codes; pm_update reports test_tasks.archived / .flagged / .needs_attention. Files: store.py, server.py, tests/test_orphan_removal_policy.py (30 tests), test_criteria_task_reconciliation.py. 71 pass; full suite 69 failed / 2493 passed (baseline 69).
